id.description: The invitation, as listed and revoked by the developer.

app_id.description: The app the invitee will belong to.

email.description: The address the invitation was addressed to.

anyOf.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

role.description: The key of the role the invitee holds once they accept, or `null` for an invitation that holds none and whose app has no default role to stand in for it. Such an invitation is answered `409 target_state_conflict` naming `default_role` when it is accepted or reissued: set the app's default role, or revoke it and invite again. A role deleted in the meantime leaves the key behind, and it grants nothing.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working. Seven days from issue; an expired token answers exactly as an unknown one does.

invitations.description: The app's outstanding invitations, without their tokens. An accepted one is history and does not appear.
